G2B-E1 slope[refs1_randk](LADDER) sign_lt_0; G2B-E2 slope[complete](LADDER) sign_gt_0; G2B-O1 slope[refs_all]-slope[refs1_randk] sign_gt_0 and slope[complete]-slope[refs_all] sign_gt_0; G2B-P1 b[refs_all]-b[refs1_randk] sign_gt_0 and b[complete]-b[refs_all] sign_gt_0
K1: G2B-P1 is FAIL on 2 or more of the 3 datasets -> drops the completeness account for this backbone and reports only that the exponent is dataset-specific
KN1: G2B-E1 is FAIL on any dataset -> the sign-flip claim (N1) is dropped from Paper A; only the ordering result can remain
'Replicates on a second backbone' may be written only for CV295 and XM600, and only where G2B-E1, G2B-E2 and G2B-O1 all PASS.
Prediction: |dP_MCP| < 0.5
Kill: |dP_MCP| > 1.0, or a 95% interval that excludes 0, means the matched-prefix control is miscalibrated: stop, and draw no matched-prefix conclusion from E1 or N9
Admissible iff |dP| <= 0.5 and its 95% interval covers 0; C* = first admissible control in the order matched prefix, sentence tie-average, uniform random subset
K-F: If |dCHAIR_i| > 1.0 or |dCHAIR_s| > 1.5, the protocol is fixed before any method look. The failed run is kept and disclosed.
P1: A method SURVIVES iff its Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 AND dP_C* >= +1.0
K-headline: If at least half of the methods (>= 3 of 6) SURVIVE on P1, the headline becomes 'training changes object choice'.
K-rank: If no pair is significantly reversed, Paper A reports N9 as 'consistent with the raw ranking' and rests no claim on it.

K-placebo: If no control is admissible on K2, P1 has no primary control. N9 reports the three per-image controls as a specification curve and makes no 'survives count control' claim, and Paper A's C1 wording becomes 'count control changes the ranking'.
Prediction (b): HELD iff D_b >= +0.3 and its 95% lower bound > 0; K-b: If D_b < 0.1, prediction (b) is dropped and N9 'shows no dk -> dm link'
(i) OLS slope beta_M < 0 and 95% CI upper bound < 0
(ii) d tau_b = tau_b(z_P, Rel) - tau_b(P_raw, Rel) >= +0.10 and CI lower bound > 0
(iii) acc_ceq - acc_cdiff > 0 and CI lower bound > 0
Overall verdict: PASS if all three tests pass, FAIL if none passes, otherwise MIXED.

VaPR.carries: human validity (PD-10 grouping; preference data, not human judgments)
rules: Pass rule: the Wilson 95% lower bound of VaPR's count-matched share exceeds each comparator's share.
Verdict rule: PASS if the pass rule holds. PARTIAL_POINT_ONLY if only the point estimate exceeds all three. FAIL otherwise.

On XM3600, two of the five registered predictions failed, both because the slope with all 2-3 references was negative, not positive; the registered demotion rule did not fire.
